signature_matches.name: forwarded export
signature_matches.description: executable/pe/export
signature_matches.rule_src:
rule:
  meta:
    name: forwarded export
    namespace: executable/pe/export
    authors:
      - ronnie.salomonsen@mandiant.com
    scopes:
      static: file
      dynamic: file
    att&ck:
      - Execution::Shared Modules [T1129]
    examples:
      - 76FA734236DAA023444DEC26863401DC
  features:
    - characteristic: forwarded export

signature_matches.name: print debug messages
signature_matches.description: host-interaction/log/debug/write-event
signature_matches.rule_src:
rule:
  meta:
    name: print debug messages
    namespace: host-interaction/log/debug/write-event
    authors:
      - michael.hunhoff@mandiant.com
    scopes:
      static: function
      dynamic: call
    examples:
      - 493167E85E45363D09495D0841C30648:0x401000
  features:
    - or:
      - api: DbgPrint
      - api: kernel32.OutputDebugString
      - and:
        - os: android
        - api: __android_log_print
